name: The Library of Bones
description: The Sphinx sends you to recover texts from a pre-war library sealed inside a Cairo government complex. The library is intact — but so are its guardians, who have been protecting it in the only way they know how for two hundred years.

stages.name: Reach the Cairo Government Complex
stages.description: Travel to the sealed government complex in central Cairo where the pre-war library is located. The Sphinx warns the approach is watched.

stages.name: Navigate the Guardians
stages.description: The guardians have protected this place for two centuries. They can be reasoned with, bypassed, or confronted — the Sphinx recommends the first option if at all possible.

stages.name: Recover the Texts
stages.description: Enter the sealed library and recover the historical records the Sphinx designated. Handle them carefully — they are among the last intact pre-war documents in North Africa.
